integrity: Universal results are derived analytically; exact-arithmetic computational checks are supplemental. Scientific priority is assessed only against accessible sources.
scientific_limitations: Two candidates on the unit policy interval with strict cost-based participation and utility equal to the unconditional voting mass.
Voting costs are independent of ideal positions and have finite nonnegative support with positive masses; ideal positions have an atomless strictly increasing CDF.
The uniform-approximation corollary uses a uniform ideal-position distribution and uniform limiting cost distribution.
Not asserted for mixed or infinite cost supports, alternative participation equality conventions, or winning-probability payoffs.
The primary source introduction and indexed results were inspected, but full appendix comparison was inaccessible; additional equivalent prior work may exist.
title: Finite voting-cost spectra erase positive-turnout equilibria
